name: Equipment Sales Co Inc.
old_description: Founded in 1989, Equipment Sales Co Inc. represents the automotive service equipment manufacturers to entire Pacific Northwest Region. We offer sales, service, and installation of automotive service equipment, in addition to design, installation, training, and inspection services.
about:
Equipment Sales Co Inc. is based in Snohomish, Washington, and was incorporated in 1989 by Scott Wilson to represent manufacturers of motor vehicle service equipment across the Pacific Northwest. In 1994, Kirby McFarland acquired the company and expanded its scope to include service work on the product lines it represented; by 1999 the firm had become a full distributor and contractor specializing in motor vehicle service equipment.

The company distributes, installs, and services a range of automotive shop equipment, including vehicle lifts with capacities from 5,500 to 120,000 pounds, lubrication dispensing and inventory systems, compressed air systems, vehicle exhaust removal systems, inventory storage systems, and wheel service equipment. It represents brands such as Rotary Lift, Graco, Shure Manufacturing, Weaver Lift, RTI, LeRoi, Hoover Group, and Champion, and also provides design services for shop layouts, operator training, safety inspections, and ALI‑certified lift inspections performed by three certified inspectors on staff.

Its customers include car and truck dealerships, independent repair shops, municipal garages, and military maintenance facilities throughout the Pacific Northwest, ranging from single‑bay operations to large multi‑bay facilities.

The business was founded to bring specialized motor vehicle service equipment to the region and has differentiated itself by maintaining factory‑trained technicians, offering turnkey installation and project management, and holding Automotive Lift Institute certification for lift inspections.

name: Era Wire Inc
old_description: WIRE STRAIGHTENING AND CUTTING, PARTS AND TOOLING, AND WIRE MACHINERY SALES SINCE 1988
about:
Era Wire Inc. was founded in 1988 by Richard T. Rae in West Haven, Connecticut. The company began as a wire straightening and cutting service and used wire machinery dealer. After physical expansion, the operation moved to its current location at 19- in West Haven in 1995. Following Richard's passing in 2015, his son Rich Jr. assumed leadership, adding an on-site distribution warehouse and through-feed centerless grinding to create a one-stop shop for ferrous and non-ferrous wire needs.

The company specializes in precision wire straightening and cutting for round, flat, and shaped materials in all tempers and alloys. Its capabilities include through-feed centerless grinding as an alternative to turning and milling, heat treating, torsion straightening, and wire forming. A Quick Wire Program stocks pre-cut 304 spring-tempered stainless steel (including 304V and 316LVM), aluminum, copper, titanium, and high/low carbon steels for same-day shipping. The facility also provides wire machinery sales, parts, and tooling.

Era Wire serves the medical device industry as a primary focus, supplying precision-straightened Bright Diamond Drawn wire with zero surface marks for Swiss screw machining. Customers also include manufacturers requiring tight-tolerance wire for electronics and general industrial applications. The company's ISO 9001:2015 certification and compliance with RoHS III, REACH Annex XVII, and California Proposition 65 support regulated sectors.

The founder's original priority—servicing the customer first—remains the company's stated differentiator, summarized in the tagline "We give it to you straight." Era Wire emphasizes its ISO 9001 certification since 2004, same-day shipping on stocked items, and the ability to process difficult materials without surface damage as reasons customers choose them.

name: Erhardt Woodworks
old_description: Erhardt Woodworks specializes in custom cabinets, painted cabinets, MDF doors, epoxy resin tables, and live-edge furniture. Every piece is handcrafted in our Bismarck, North Dakota workshop and tailored to fit your home, business, or remodeling project. Whether you need a single live-edge table or a full kitchen cabinet installation, our team handles the entire process, from design to installation.
about:
Erhardt Woodworks operates from a workshop and showroom in Bismarck, North Dakota, serving the surrounding communities of Mandan, Lincoln, and greater Burleigh and Morton Counties. The company fabricates custom cabinetry, epoxy resin tables, and live-edge furniture for residential, commercial, and industrial projects across the region.

The shop produces European-style cabinets, painted cabinets, MDF doors and drawer fronts, Baltic birch dovetail drawer boxes, epoxy resin tables, and live-edge countertops and tables. Work flows from design consultation through fabrication, finishing, delivery, and installation, all managed in-house. Materials include solid hardwoods, MDF, high-quality veneers, Baltic birch, and premium resin systems sourced from suppliers.

Customers range from homeowners remodeling kitchens or adding vanity cabinets to businesses outfitting commercial spaces. The company handles projects of varying scale — from a single live-edge table to full kitchen installations — and coordinates shipping or contractor-supported installation for clients outside its immediate service area.

Erhardt Woodworks emphasizes a commitment to customer satisfaction, attention to detail, and a skilled, experienced team. It positions its professional service as an alternative to DIY approaches, offering design collaboration, color and finish matching, reasonable pricing, flexible payment options, convenient hours, and a showroom where clients can view samples before committing.

name: Ernest Packaging Solutions
old_description: As a trusted food packaging company, we’ve earned a strong reputation as experts in the design, manufacturing and distribution of high-quality food packaging solutions. Our team specializes in creating innovative, sustainable packaging that preserves food quality, enhances shelf life and meets industry regulations.
about:
Ernest Packaging Solutions operates a Boise-area facility in Nampa, Idaho, serving the greater Boise metro market and beyond. The company is a nationally operated packaging provider with a local touch, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs, manufactures, and distributes custom packaging solutions across food, beverage, pharmaceutical, medical, cosmetics, retail, display, and industrial segments. Its offerings extend to branded packaging, sustainable and biodegradable options, temperature-controlled cold-chain packaging, and industrial-grade protective packaging. Ernest also supplies packaging equipment — including conveyor systems, case sealers, and full line integration — along with packaging and facility supplies managed through just-in-time inventory and bulk-order programs.

Customers span food and beverage producers such as Pizza Port Brewing Company and Sol-ti, pharmaceutical and medical device firms, and industrial shippers like The Rag Company and Coast Aluminum. Retail and consumer-goods clients include Carolina Coops, 7 Points, and No Toil. The company cites its client relationship managers as a differentiator, noting they proactively identify improvement areas rather than simply selling boxes.

Ernest emphasizes full-service capability — combining design, manufacturing, and distribution under one roof — along with a sustainability focus that aligns with Idaho initiatives. Its temperature-controlled packaging aims to maintain precise conditions for perishables and pharmaceuticals, while equipment automation targets reduced manual labor and smoother operations.

old_description: for over half a century. Founded in 1965, we’ve built our reputation on craftsmanship, experience, and dependable service.
about:
ESCO Manufacturing Inc. was founded in 1965 in Watertown, South Dakota, where it remains headquartered. The company operates two dedicated facilities in the state and has spent over half a century as a wholesale sign manufacturer serving the Midwest and beyond.

The company produces custom signs, channel letters, cabinets, and faces, offering full-service manufacturing from design assistance through final production. Its team of tenured professionals handles projects of any size, style, or quantity, including specialized church, school, and municipal signage. The operation emphasizes precision and the capacity to manage complex, large-scale projects.

ESCO’s customer base consists primarily of independent sign companies and contractors across the United States. Long-term clients cited in testimonials include JH Signs, All State Signs (Great Falls, MT), Sandmann Signs & Electric Inc., Indigo Signworks, AP Design, Total Motors, and Affordable Signs. These partners rely on ESCO for channel letter fabrication, custom cabinet work, and project management support.

The company highlights its full-service manufacturing model, deep industry expertise, and a customer-first approach that includes dedicated account representatives and fast turnaround times.

name: Everbrite Electronics Inc
old_description: Providing Innovative Visual Identification Solutions Since 1927
about:
Everbrite Electronics Inc., headquartered in Greenfield, Wisconsin, was founded in 1927. The company operates as a woman-owned and minority-owned business, certified as a Women's Business Enterprise (WBE) since 2002. It began as a provider of visual identification solutions and has grown into one of the largest full-service signage companies in the United States.

Everbrite designs, manufactures, and installs a range of branding solutions including outdoor signage, indoor signs and displays, menu systems, architectural and drive-thru elements, electronic displays, scoreboards, and LED lighting. The company operates five sales and manufacturing facilities across the United States, offering multi-plant manufacturing capabilities and high-volume production capacity. A network of over 200 preferred installers provides nationwide installation and service, supported by site surveys, code research, permit procurement, and branding guideline development.

The company serves brands and retailers worldwide, managing Tier I and Tier II supplier diversity programs. Its client base spans commercial, retail, and institutional sectors, though specific customer names are not disclosed in public materials.

Everbrite differentiates itself through design and engineering excellence, state-of-the-art manufacturing, experienced account management, and consistent financial stability. Its status as the largest Minority/WBE signage company in the U.S. underscores its commitment to supplier diversity and customer satisfaction.

name: Evolution Furniture
old_description: Evolution Furniture specializes in creating unique, custom-built furnishings for both commercial businesses and residential homes. Our team's experience and creativity enable us to tackle even the most challenging projects, and we manage every aspect, from the initial concept to the final delivery.
about:
Based in Naperville, Illinois, Evolution Furniture has built a reputation for custom-built furnishings since its inception. The company operates from a facility at 576 W. 5th Avenue, serving the Chicago metropolitan area with a focus on craftsmanship and quality in the design community.

The shop fabricates custom furniture from concept to installation, offering services that include custom furniture fabrication, restoration, upholstery, custom painting, and repair. A five-step process — Define, Discover, Design, Develop, Deliver — guides each project: the team analyzes client vision, researches materials and styles, produces sketches and 3D renderings, develops technical drawings for skilled craftsmen, and manages delivery and placement. The company emphasizes hands-on project management, handling sourcing, production, assembly, and on-site installation for orders ranging from single pieces to large commercial installations.

Evolution Furniture serves commercial businesses, residential homeowners, and interior designers across the Chicago region. Notable commercial projects include furnishings for Uber Headquarters, the Chicago Bears Halas Hall, Mondelez International, and the 1326 S Michigan development. The firm also partners with the American Society of Interior Designers (ASID) and lists a service area covering Naperville, Chicago, Glencoe, Barrington, Winnetka, and numerous surrounding suburbs.

The company states its promise is "distinctive custom furniture of incomparable quality, always delivered on time and on budget." Its approach centers on listening to client needs, evaluating the space firsthand, and collaborating closely through design iterations to ensure the final piece meets functional and aesthetic goals.

old_description: Evolution St. Louis - the premier high-tech knitting facility using cutting-edge 3D and complete garment seamless knitting technology - is creating the manufacturing facility and supply chain of the future. We revitalize the knit industry, allow American brands and retailers to keep pace with emerging trends, and make St. Louis the industry sector for advanced knitting and manufacturing.
about:
Evolution St. Louis operates a high-tech knitting facility in St. Louis, Missouri, building on the city's fashion industry heritage. The company was established to revitalize the flat-bed knit sector using the latest seamless knitting technology and to create new manufacturing jobs in the United States.

The facility runs STOLL ADF and CMS knit and wear® machines capable of 3D and complete garment knitting. It produces fully fashioned knits and sweaters knit to shape, footwear, smart textiles, and technical textiles, achieving complex shapes with minimal waste. Services include product engineering, prototyping, material sourcing and development, technology integration, IP protection, testing, linking, sewing, finishing, labeling, barcoding, and hangtag application. Small batch production is enabled by short setup times.

Customers span apparel, footwear, and accessories brands; technical and smart textile developers; automotive and aerospace suppliers; home and furniture makers; lifestyle, sports, health, and wellness companies; and medical technology, police, fire, and transit agencies. The company targets American brands and retailers seeking to keep pace with emerging trends.

Evolution St. Louis positions itself as creating the manufacturing facility and supply chain of the future, aiming to make St. Louis a hub for advanced knitting and manufacturing.

name: Evotronics Inc
old_description: We are the trusted Provider of printed circuit board (PCB) contract manufacturing services in the Minneapolis / St. Paul area
about:
Evotronics Inc is a family-owned PCB contract manufacturing service company based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Founded in 1995 by Tam Tran, the business is now led by co-owners Anh Tran and Ken Nguyen. The company began as a provider of design, manufacture, test, distribution, and return/repair services for electronic components and assemblies to original equipment manufacturers.

The shop specializes in printed circuit board assembly, offering through-hole, surface-mount, and mixed-technology builds, along with custom cable assembly, electro-mechanical integration, and full box-build services including decals, serialization, and labeling. Its facility is climate-controlled and monitored by a surveillance system. Capabilities extend to automated axial insertion (ammo pack and cut tape), semi-automatic radial preparation, hand placement for odd-shaped components, conformal coating (UV, epoxy), in-line wash, and rework or engineering modifications after completion. The company emphasizes quick-turn prototypes and small-to-medium production runs, with the ability to scale to higher volumes.

Evotronics serves OEMs across retail, consumer, industrial, medical, and defense/aerospace sectors. Customers rely on the firm for first-article testing, design-for-manufacturing feedback, bill-of-materials alternative sourcing, and a no-stencil solder-paste process that accelerates prototype starts.

The company highlights its ESD-safe environment (third-party audited), UL certification, ISO 9001:2015 registration, and FDA registration as pillars of its quality system, alongside an RF enclosure room for specialized testing.
